requirement_evidence.evidence: Implemented ready, claim, submit, review, release, and status subcommands in scripts/week4_tasks.py with registry revision verification.
Acquires exclusive OS locks via fcntl.flock; atomic writes via tempfile + os.replace. Normalized paths prevent lock aliasing as tested in test_claim_acquires_lock_and_blocks_collision_and_aliases.
Blocks claim if dependencies are unverified or write sets overlap. Verified by test_claim_blocked_dependencies.
No automatic lock theft on timeout. Releasing a claim requires explicit non-empty reason as verified by test_release_requires_mandatory_reason.
validate_receipt_file verifies template_only=false, nonempty passing command records, and requirement evidence mappings. Verified by test_submit_validates_receipt_file.
Separates review action from author action (rejecting self-review without override). Verified by test_review_requires_independent_reviewer.
All unit tests in tests/test_week4_task_claims.py execute on disposable temporary fixtures without mutating production registry.

scientific_dispositions: Coordination utility strictly isolates task execution to prevent concurrent write collisions in collaborative research.
limitations: Advisory file locking operates within same host/filesystem; multi-node coordination requires external distributed locking.
